newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Botswana Pep raises H1 attrib 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Botswana Pep raises H1 attrib 20 percent.

text.p: Full name: Pep Botswana Holdings Limited
NOTE - The comparative figures have been calculated on a pro-forma basis as this is the first interim report since Pep changed its year-end from February to June.

The directors said in a statement that the refurbishment of selected stores, an aggressive marketing campaign together with a slight improvement in certain sectors of the economy contributed to the improved results. Tight control of operating expenses ensured that the company maintained acceptable profit margins.

The board was confident that the present growth in earnings would be maintained for the whole of the current financial year. Pep has 36 outlets. One additional store would be opened during the second half of the financial year whilst one was closed at the end of January 1997.
